india.one_line: MeitY examined in-home video data collection, ReNew pledged ₹80,000 crore for green data centers, Niti Aayog warned of capital concentration, and the DPDP consent manager portal opened.

themes.title: MeitY reviews data practices and opens consent portal
themes.text: MeitY questioned home services platforms regarding in-home video data collection by gig workers for physical AI models and opened a registration portal for DPDP Act consent managers.

stories.headline: MeitY questions home services platforms over in-home video data collection for AI
MeitY opens DPDP Act consent manager registration portal

themes.title: ReNew pledges ₹80,000 crore for data centre
themes.text: ReNew Energy Global announced an investment of approximately ₹80,000 crore in Andhra Pradesh to build a 1 GW green hyperscale data centre and clean energy manufacturing facilities.

stories.headline: ReNew pledges ₹80,000 cr for green data centre and manufacturing in Andhra Pradesh

themes.title: Niti Aayog warns of AI capital concentration
themes.text: Niti Aayog's Debjani Ghosh warned that the concentration of capital, influence, and circular financing among a handful of companies poses systemic risks to the AI industry.

stories.headline: Niti Aayog's Debjani Ghosh warns AI risk lies in capital and power concentration
